data.title: AI-Enhanced BEC — Payment Request Behavioral Divergence from Sender Baseline
data.description: Detects AI-enhanced business email compromise by identifying wire transfer requests where the communication pattern diverges significantly from the sender's established baseline. FBI IC3 2025 reported $30 million in losses from AI-enabled BEC where chat generators created official-sounding emails mimicking company executives and voice cloning was used for wire authorization requests. AI-generated BEC content, while linguistically fluent, often lacks the sender's authentic communication patterns — writing style, formality level, time-of-day preferences, typical request amounts, and approval workflows. This rule targets Phase 3 (Positioning) where the fraudulent request is crafted and delivered, before the wire transfer is executed.

enrichment_required.source: NLP-derived score measuring deviation in writing style (word choice, sentence length, formality, urgency markers) from sender's 90-day communication baseline. Score in standard deviations.
Requested amount as percentage of sender's median wire request amount over trailing 12 months
Boolean — whether the request was sent outside the sender's established communication hours (based on 90-day pattern)

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for AI-Enhanced BEC Behavioral Divergence
// Detects wire requests with communication patterns diverging from sender baseline
request_type="wire_transfer_request"
request_channel="email"
(sender_style_divergence_score>=2.0
 OR (request_amount_vs_sender_baseline_pct>=200 AND request_outside_sender_typical_hours="true"))
| groupBy(sender_email, function=[
    collect([request_id, request_amount, request_date, request_time,
             beneficiary_name, sender_style_divergence_score]),
    count(request_id, as=flagged_requests),
    sum(request_amount, as=total_requested)
  ])
| sort(total_requested, order=desc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for AI-Enhanced BEC Behavioral Divergence")`
`comment("Detects wire requests with communication patterns diverging from sender baseline")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
  request_type="wire_transfer_request"
  request_channel="email"
| where sender_style_divergence_score >= 2.0
    OR (request_amount_vs_sender_baseline_pct >= 200
        AND request_outside_sender_typical_hours="true")
| eval divergence_type = case(
    sender_style_divergence_score >= 3.0, "severe_style_divergence",
    sender_style_divergence_score >= 2.0, "moderate_style_divergence",
    1=1, "amount_timing_anomaly")
| stats count AS flagged_requests, sum(request_amount) AS total_requested,
    values(beneficiary_name) AS beneficiaries,
    values(divergence_type) AS divergence_types,
    max(sender_style_divergence_score) AS max_divergence
    by sender_email, sender_name
| eval risk_score = case(
    max_divergence >= 3.0 AND total_requested > 100000, "critical",
    max_divergence >= 2.0 AND total_requested > 50000, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| sort - total_requested

references: FBI IC3, 2025 Internet Crime Report — AI-enabled BEC: $30M in losses; total BEC: $3.046B
FBI IC3, 2025 — AI-related fraud: 22,364 complaints, $893M total losses
FBI IC3 PSA250904, September 4, 2025 — ABA Foundation and FBI Deepfake Scam Infographic
falsepositives: Executives writing under time pressure with atypical brevity or urgency
Emails sent by executive assistants on behalf of the named sender
Automated or template-based payment requests that differ from freeform communication style
Cross-timezone communications appearing outside normal hours
